items.title: XREAL Announces ‘1 Pro+’ Flagship AR Glasses, Now Available & Priced at $599
items.summary:
XREAL today announced XREAL 1 Pro+, a hardware refresh of its One Pro flagship AR glasses. Launching today at $599, Xreal 1 Pro+ includes a modest set of improvements over the original One Pro, which launched in early 2025. Principally, Xreal 1 Pro+ includes brighter displays, as well as improvements to spatial viewing and comfort. […]

items.title: You Can Get Inside Hollywood's Exclusive Magic Castle On Apple Vision Pro
items.summary: Hollywood's Magic Castle is an exclusive club, but the 'You Are Here' immersive video for Apple Vision Pro lets you step inside to witness the magic up close.
